claims: Artemis II is a manned mission.
Artemis II is launched in April 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of NASA's Artemis program.
Artemis II sends four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon and back to Earth.
Crew members of Artemis II are Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (all NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (Canadian Space Agency).
Artemis II is a lunar flyby.
Artemis II is designed to test life support systems, communications, and navigation.
Crew of Artemis II travels aboard the Orion spacecraft.
Orion spacecraft is launched by the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Apollo 17 was the last crewed mission to the Moon before Artemis II.
